name: George Klein
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: George (they/them) is a Gestalt psychotherapist working in private practice, providing therapy to individuals, couples, and relationships. George's practice is built on inclusivity, offering a warm, welcoming, and compassionate space for everyone, including LGBTQIA+ communities, neurodivergent people, and those in monogamous and non-monogamous relationships. George is particularly interested in working with relationship issues, life transitions and change, meaning and purpose, grief and loss, perimenopause, identity, self-expression, self-esteem and sex positivity, and anxiety and depression, among other areas.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Auður Zoega
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: My approach to integrative psychotherapy is rooted in a deep understanding of the significance of human relationships in shaping our well-being. I believe that many common issues people face are often linked to their past and present relationships. My work encompasses a wide range of concerns, from interpersonal difficulties to childhood experiences, self-esteem, and creativity.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Lisa Stephens
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: As a specialist relationship counsellor, I support couples and individuals in navigating relationship challenges, these might be intimate partnerships, a friendship that has become difficult or a family or work relationship. By creating a safe, non-judgmental space to explore emotions, I help you gain clarity on what you want and what’s possible in your relationships. Together, we work towards building healthier, more secure connections, repairing relationship ruptures, and improving communication.

name: Catherine Angel
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I’m Catherine, a PACFA accredited Clinical Counsellor based in Melbourne. I specialise in supporting adults who feel stuck in unhealthy cycles and are searching for a way out. Many of the people I work with face challenges such as substance use disorders, behavioural addictions, intimacy issues, love and sex addiction, avoidance patterns, co-dependency, or the pain of being a betrayed partner.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery
